method count_lowercase_odd(txt: string) returns (count: int)

    ensures count >= 0
    ensures count == CountLowercaseOdd(txt)

    requires txt != null
    ensures flag ==> (txt.Contains(" ") || txt.Contains("\t") || txt.Contains("\n")) // Check for whitespace

method count_commas_split(txt: string) returns (flag: bool)
    requires txt != null
    ensures flag ==> txt.Contains(",") // Check for commas

method CountLowercaseOdd(txt: string) returns (count: int)
    requires txt != null
    ensures count >= 0
    ensures count == CountLowercaseOddInternal(txt)
